declared.title: How to handle anxiety: The effects of reappraisal, acceptance, and suppression strategies on anxious arousal
declared.foundIn: agent contre-preuve, recherche Crossref / Europe PMC du 2026-11-22 (reports/feeling-bad-about-feeling-bad/counter-evidence.md) ; titre relevé sur Crossref par l'agent : contrôle d'identité plus faible

population: 202 volunteers giving an impromptu speech, randomly assigned

findings.text: Accepting anxiety did not make people feel less anxious than suppressing it

support.sentence: However, the Acceptance and Suppression groups did not differ in their subjective anxiety response.

findings.text: Rethinking the situation calmed the felt anxiety better than accepting or suppressing it

support.sentence: However, reappraising is more effective for moderating the subjective feeling of anxiety than attempts to suppress or accept it.
